كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَى supplies the predicate content of إِنَّ.
أَظْلَمَ is the predicate of كَانُوا.
أَطْغَىٰ is coordinated with أَظْلَمَ by وَ as the second comparative predicate.
أَطْغَىٰ shares the predicate function of أَظْلَمَ for كَانُوا through coordination.
ٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ is accusative and precedes أَهْوَىٰ as its object.
The suffix هَا on غَشَّىٰهَا is the direct object of the first غَشَّىٰ.
The phrase مَا غَشَّىٰ supplies the subject of غَشَّىٰهَا.
Within مَا غَشَّىٰ, مَا is read as the subject of the second غَشَّىٰ.
أَىِّ is governed by بِ and supplies the prepositional complement of تَتَمَارَىٰ.
ءَالَاءِ is the genitive complement of the construct interrogative أَىِّ.
رَبِّكَ is the genitive possessor in ءَالَاءِ رَبِّكَ.
The suffix كَ on رَبِّكَ is the genitive possessor of رَبِّ.
نَذِيرٌ predicates about هَٰذَا in the nominal sentence.
ٱلنُّذُرِ is governed by مِنَ and qualifies نَذِيرٌ partitivally.
ٱلْأُولَىٰ agrees with ٱلنُّذُرِ and describes the former warners.
ٱلْءَازِفَةُ follows أَزِفَتِ as the feminine subject.
هَا is governed by لَ and the phrase لَهَا attaches to لَيْسَ.
لَهَا is the fronted predicate of لَيْسَ.
دُونِ is governed by مِنْ and restricts كَاشِفَةٌ to what is apart from Allah.
ٱللَّهِ is the genitive complement of the construct دُونِ.
كَاشِفَةٌ is the nominative subject of لَيْسَ.
هَٰذَا is governed by مِنْ and marks what تَعْجَبُونَ is about.
ٱلْحَدِيثِ appositionally specifies هَٰذَا under the same مِنْ phrase.
تَبْكُونَ is coordinated with تَضْحَكُونَ by وَ with لَا negating the second verb.
سَٰمِدُونَ predicates the state of أَنتُمْ.
لَّهِ is governed by لِ and supplies the complement of ٱسْجُدُوا.
ٱعْبُدُوا is coordinated with ٱسْجُدُوا by وَ as a second imperative.
